name: KIC 11758055
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 15.3 solar radii and 1.53 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11758055 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 15.3112 +/- 0.2863

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11758055 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.5279 +/- 0.0639

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11758055 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4646.2505 +/- 43.2658

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 11758055 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.2472 +/- 0.0042

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.53 solar masses and 15.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,646 K at its surface.
